per_case.title: Internal HR/IT policy assistant (RAG)
per_case.tests: The floor of the scale: an in-scope Gen AI tool that must NOT be inflated above low.

per_case.title: Rule-based invoice reconciliation bot marketed as AI
per_case.tests: Out of scope under Section 1.1 despite being sold internally as 'AI-powered'. Reads the mechanism, not the label.

per_case.title: One-line request with almost no detail
per_case.tests: Calibration under missing information: must not claim high confidence from a single sentence.

per_case.title: Personal loan underwriting model
per_case.tests: The handbook's own example of a use case that stays high; human review of declines must not lower the INHERENT tier.

per_case.title: LLM CV screening for a graduate programme
per_case.tests: Deliberately downplayed ('never rejects anyone outright'). The employment floor must hold the final tier at high.

per_case.title: Multi-agent relationship-manager assistant with trade execution
per_case.tests: Agentic compounding: tool access, irreversibility, and the never-delegate boundary.

per_case.title: Vendor-embedded AI feature in a procurement platform
per_case.tests: Third-party onboarding: Considerations 4 and 10 are the discriminator, and opacity should not read as low risk.

per_case.title: Face matching and liveness at digital account opening
per_case.tests: Biometric identification: personal-data and fairness dimensions must all rate high.

per_case.title: Campaign copy drafting with editorial approval
per_case.tests: The middle of the scale: reputational and content risk without decisions about individuals.

per_case.title: Customer-facing chatbot that issues refunds unaided
per_case.tests: Autonomous customer-facing money movement: oversight mode must not be human out of the loop.
